#!/bin/sh
set -eu

source_parent=/srv/inventory
source_name=data
backup_dir=/var/backups/inventory

if [ ! -d "$source_parent/$source_name" ]; then
    printf 'Backup source is not a directory: %s\n' "$source_parent/$source_name" >&2
    exit 1
fi

umask 077
install -d -o root -g root -m 0700 "$backup_dir"
stamp=$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)
archive="$backup_dir/inventory-$stamp-$$.tar.gz"
temporary="$archive.tmp"
cleanup() {
    rm -f -- "$temporary"
}
trap cleanup 0 1 2 15

tar -C "$source_parent" -czf "$temporary" "$source_name"
chmod 0600 "$temporary"
mv -f -- "$temporary" "$archive"
temporary=''

find "$backup_dir" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'inventory-*.tar.gz' -printf '%T@ %p\n' \
    | sort -rn \
    | sed -n '8,$p' \
    | cut -d ' ' -f 2- \
    | while IFS= read -r expired; do
        [ -n "$expired" ] && rm -f -- "$expired"
      done

printf 'Created %s\n' "$archive"
ANTRIEB_BACKUP_SCRIPT
sh -n "$tmp_file"
install -o root -g root -m 0750 "$tmp_file" /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup
printf 'installed='; stat -c '%U:%G %a %n' /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup
printf 'destination='; stat -c '%U:%G %a %n' /var/backups/inventory
